WITH 
  percent_change AS (
    SELECT 
      "District", 
      "State", 
      "Survey Round", 
      "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS percent_literate,
      NULLIF("Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)", 0) AS percent_literate_denom,
      NULLIF("Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)", 0) - 
      NULLIF(LAG("Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)") OVER (ORDER BY "District", "State", "Survey Round"), 0) AS percent_change
    FROM 
      "district_health_factsheet"
  ),
  filtered AS (
    SELECT 
      "District", 
      "State", 
      "Survey Round", 
      percent_change
    FROM 
      percent_change
    WHERE 
      "Survey Round" IN ("NFHS-4", "NFHS-5")
  )
SELECT 
  "District", 
  "State", 
  "Survey Round", 
  percent_change
FROM 
  filtered
WHERE 
  "Survey Round" = "NFHS-5" AND 
  percent_change > 0;
